title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 14
intro: Round 14 (2026-11-07). Round 13 is in. Who to Contact, and When, checked part by part after the Human first half of Psychological First Aid: its opening paragraph was the strongest pull toward AI, and its integration list reads Human as it is. One card, one sentence. The first list and the directories still read AI together; I'm working on the words around their facts next, and For the Person Helping after that. Round 12's card is still open on its own page.

suggestions.what: "Hours and services change, and not every option works in every country." becomes "Their hours and services change, and some only work in one country."
suggestions.why: "Not every option works in every country" is a stock hedge; saying which ones (some only work in one country) is plainer and still true of the list: Fireside and 988 are U.S.-only, and Crisis Text Line names its partner lines.
